checks.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user that there are 10 t-shirt options available.
checks.justification: The agent told the user there are 12 variants of T-shirts available, but the tool data shows 12 total variants (10 available + 2 unavailable). The expected outcome states 10 options, which likely refers to available options. The agent incorrectly stated 12 instead of distinguishing between total variants and available options.
